ImageDescription.value: The 19th-century covered shopping arcade features a grand symmetric interior flanked by two multi-story Italianate stone facades decorated with columns, arched window bays, and continuous rows of globe streetlamps, all sheltered by a massive glass-paned barrel-vaulted roof with an iron framework that leads to a central archway bearing a monumental clock dial and the Belgian flag.
